score_rationale: The candidate shows strong programming and Windows skills but lacks the essential first-line IT support experience, experience with school systems (Intune/AD/AV), and any background working with children or safeguarding, which are core to the role.
key_strengths: Strong proficiency in Python and Windows environments; proven ability to mentor and teach technical concepts to others.
key_weaknesses: No evidence of hardware/first-line IT support, device imaging, Intune or Active Directory management, AV equipment, or experience working with children in an educational setting; overqualified for the technician level and geographically mismatched (based in South Africa).
final_evaluation: While the candidate's technical depth in software engineering is impressive, the role requires hands‑on school IT support and direct interaction with young people—areas where the candidate has no demonstrable experience. Consequently, the fit for this position is poor.
